agents.description: Assesses vocal variety, pace, pauses, filler words, energy, and projection to evaluate presentation delivery effectiveness.
Evaluates logical flow, organization, transitions, introduction clarity, and conclusion impact of the presentation structure.
Assesses confidence, authority, gravitas, composure, and leadership demeanor conveyed during the presentation.
Evaluates clarity of technical explanations, appropriate use of jargon, visual aid effectiveness, and complexity management.
Assesses audience interaction techniques, storytelling effectiveness, rhetorical questions, and attention-holding strategies.
Evaluates time management, segment balance, content density, speed variation, and appropriate use of pauses throughout the presentation.
Assesses argument strength, evidence usage, call-to-action clarity, emotional appeal, and overall persuasive impact of the presentation.
